A previous study performed on this material had shown that all examined Lundehunds had gastritis and about 30% had gastric carcinoma. Neutral and acid mucins were identified using the periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) and Alcian blue (pH 2.5) periodic acid-Schiff (AB-PAS) methods. The acid mucins were divided into sialomucins and sulfomucins based on their reaction with high-iron diamine Alcian blue, pH 2.5 (HID-AB).
